_doc.about: session-archive settings. Created by session-archive on its first run; plugin updates never touch this file. Every key holds its default, so this file behaves exactly like having none. Flags win over environment variables (SESSION_ARCHIVE_DIR, SESSION_ARCHIVE_PROJECTS), which win over this file. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Paths may start with ~; a relative path is taken from the archive folder (out_dir and projects_dir: from the folder the command runs in).
_doc.projects_dir: Claude Code transcripts folder. null = $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects, else ~/.claude/projects.
_doc.min_turns: Sessions with fewer user turns are skipped as trivial.
_doc.min_kb: Sessions smaller than this many KB are skipped as trivial.
_doc.live_minutes: A transcript written in the last N minutes is live (usually this session) and waits.
_doc.exclude: Project folder names to skip: a plain entry matches anywhere, "^x" matches names starting with x.
_doc.state_dir: Run history, lock and last-run.json. null = <archive>/.state.
_doc.skipped_file: Sessions skipped on purpose (JSON lines). null = <state_dir>/skipped.jsonl.
_doc.skipped_hash_chars: Hex characters of the transcript sha256 to record.
_doc.index_file: One line per pair. null or "" = no index.
_doc.index_header: Written once when the index file is created. null = nothing.
_doc.index_heading: Template written before each run's index lines. "" = none.
_doc.index_line: Template for each pair's index line.
_doc.index_continuation_note: What {continuation_note} becomes for a continuation pair.
_doc.log_file: One entry per run. null or "" = no log.
_doc.log_position: "end" appends; "top" puts the newest entry first, under the # title line.
_doc.log_heading: Template for each run's log heading.
_doc.log_item: Template for each pair under the log heading.
_doc.pre_command: Runs before run archives anything (a string goes through the shell; a list runs as is). Non-zero exit stops the run. null = none.
_doc.post_command: Runs after run, with the result in its environment. null = none.
_doc.digest: Digest labels (string, list of accepted labels, or null to leave a field out), field order, field_prefix, session_format ({id}), range_separator, none, headings, speakers, speaker_inline. The README has the details.
